title: Best Places to Visit in December in India 2026
summary: Plan the best places to visit in December in India 2026, with snow, beaches, desert festivals and a Christmas long weekend plan by bus.
body_markdown:
December 2026 comes with a calendar advantage. Christmas falls on a Friday, which creates a clean three day weekend from 25 to 27 December, and that changes how many people will plan the month. Knowing where to go, and when to book, matters more than usual this year.


## **How to Use This December Planner**


This guide sorts the best places to visit in December in India by what you want from the trip, whether that is snow, beaches, heritage cities, festivals or a quiet break. It also includes a Christmas long weekend plan and a simple booking timeline.


Most places below can be reached by bus from a major city. If you are starting from the capital, the[Delhi bus booking page](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-bus-booking-online) is a good place to check live departures before you commit to a destination.


# **Best Places to Visit in December in India: A 2026 Planner**


December is the start of India’s main travel season. Most of the country is dry and comfortable, the mountains turn cold and the south and the coast are at their best. The trick is picking one theme and matching it to the right place.


## **What December Looks Like Across India**


North India is cold, and fog can be heavy in the plains. The hills are colder still, with snow more likely in January and February than in early December. The south and the west coast are dry and pleasant, which makes them the easiest places for warm weather.


That split drives most December choices. If you want cold air and mountain views, go north. If you want a beach, a heritage walk or a festival evening without a heavy jacket, go south or west.


## **Quick Picks: Where to Go in December 2026**


The table below gives a fast answer before the details. Each pick is explained in the sections that follow.


**If you want** **Go to**


Cold mountains and a chance of snow Manali, Shimla or Dharamshala


Lakes, palaces and heritage Udaipur or Jaipur


Beaches Goa, Varkala or Pondicherry


A cool hill station in the south Ooty


A desert festival Rann Utsav in Kutch


A cultural festival Hornbill Festival, Nagaland


## **Snow and Mountain Trips**


Mountain trips are the classic December plan, though snow is not guaranteed in the first half of the month. Go for the cold, the clear air and the views, and treat any snowfall as a bonus. Higher villages are more likely to see snow than the towns themselves.


### **Manali, Himachal Pradesh**


Manali stays busy in December, with Solang Valley, Old Manali and the Hadimba Temple as the usual stops. It is cold, so pack heavy layers. See the[Delhi to Manali bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-manali-bus-route) for current services.


### **Shimla, Himachal Pradesh**


Shimla is the easier hill option, with the Ridge, Mall Road and the Jakhu Temple close together. It suits shorter trips and families who want less driving. Check the[Delhi to Shimla bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-shimla-bus-route) for departures.


### **Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj, Himachal Pradesh**


This pair offers mountain views and a cafe-led pace, with the Dhauladhar range as the backdrop. The[Delhi to Dharamshala bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-dharamshala-bus-route) lists current services. Expect cold nights and clear mornings.


## **Heritage, Lakes and Desert in Rajasthan and Kutch**


Rajasthan is at its best in December. Days are pleasant, evenings are cool and the lakes and forts are far more comfortable to explore than in summer. Udaipur is the lake city, and the[Delhi to Udaipur bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-udaipur-bus-route) connects it with the capital. Jaipur is closer, and the[Delhi to Jaipur bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-jaipur-bus-route) lists a daytime and overnight choice.


Further west, Rann Utsav at Dhordo in Kutch is listed for 1 November 2026 to 7 March 2027, with the Christmas and New Year period running from 18 December to 2 January. Those weeks are the busiest, so book tents early. The main gateways are Bhuj Airport and Bhuj Railway Station.


## **Beaches and the South**


The south is a dependable December choice. The weather is dry, the sea is calm and the festival calendar fills up from mid month.


- Goa: Busiest around Christmas and New Year. The[Bangalore to Goa bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/bangalore-to-goa-bus-route) connects it with the south.
- Varkala: A cliff top beach town in Kerala. See the[Chennai to Varkala bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-varkala-bus-route) .
- Pondicherry: A short coastal trip from Chennai. Check the[Chennai to Puducherry bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-puducherry-bus-route) .
- Ooty: Cool and green, with cold nights. See the[Chennai to Ooty bus route](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-ooty-bus-route) .


## **December 2026 Festivals Worth Planning Around**


A festival can anchor a whole trip. These are the ones most often listed for December 2026, though dates can change, so confirm with the organisers.


- Hornbill Festival: Listed for 1 to 10 December 2026 at Kisama Heritage Village near Kohima in Nagaland.
- Rann Utsav: The tent city at Dhordo runs through the season, with peak demand around Christmas and New Year.
- Chennai music season: A month-long run of concerts that begins in mid December and continues into January.
- Sunburn Mumbai: Listed for 18 and 19 December 2026.
- Christmas: Friday 25 December, which creates the long weekend.


## **Best Places to Visit in December in India on a Long Weekend**


Christmas falls on a Friday, so the long weekend runs from Friday 25 to Sunday 27 December. Pick a destination that does not eat up the whole break in travel.


**Route** **Journey**


[Delhi to Jaipur](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-jaipur-bus-route) A run of about 6 hours is listed on zingbus, which leaves most of three days for the city.


[Chennai to Puducherry](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/chennai-to-puducherry-bus-route) A short coastal route, suited to a relaxed weekend by the sea.


[Bangalore to Goa](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/bangalore-to-goa-bus-route) An overnight run to the coast, best with a Thursday night departure.


[Delhi to Udaipur](https://www.zingbus.com/bus-tickets/delhi-to-udaipur-bus-route) An overnight run to Rajasthan’s lake city, best with a Thursday night or Friday night departure.


Shorter routes leave more time at the destination, while overnight routes mean you arrive early and can use the first day. Either way, book both legs together, since return slots on Sunday evening fill quickly.


## **December Travel Plan India: A Simple Booking Timeline**


A December trip is easiest when you work backwards from the date. The Christmas and New Year stretch is the busiest window, so earlier is better.


- Four to six weeks before: Choose the destination, confirm your dates and shortlist stays.
- Two to three weeks before: Book the bus both ways and confirm your first night’s stay.
- One week before: Check the weather, road conditions and any fog advisories.
- The day before: Charge your phone, pack layers and save your ticket and boarding point.


## **Winter Travel Tips: Fog, Cold and Packing**


December travel is pleasant, but a few winter habits make it smoother. These apply to most of the places above.


- Fog: Dense fog in north India can delay departures and arrivals, so avoid tight connections.
- Layers: Pack for cold mornings and warmer afternoons, and carry a jacket even on a bus.
- Night driving: On hill roads, choose daylight transfers where you can.
- Phone: Keep a power bank and an offline map in case signal drops.
- Price disclaimer: Prices are approximate and may vary based on season, demand, and availability, so check live rates on your travel dates.


## **Choosing Your December Trip**


The best December trip is the one that matches your idea of rest. If you want cold air and views, go north. If you want a beach or a festival, go south or west. If you only have a long weekend, keep the journey short.


Pick the place, then book the bus and the first night’s stay together. December sells out earlier each year, and a simple plan made a few weeks ahead usually costs less and feels calmer.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What are the best places to visit in December in India?**


The best places to visit in December in India include Manali, Shimla, Udaipur, Jaipur, Goa, Varkala, Pondicherry and Ooty.


### **Which places are best in December 2026?**


For December 2026, Rajasthan, the south coast and the Himalayan hills are strong choices, depending on whether you want warmth or cold.


### **Will it snow in December in Manali or Shimla?**


Snow in December is possible in the higher hills, but it is more likely in January and February than in early December.


### **What is the best place for a long weekend in December?**


For the 25 to 27 December long weekend, short routes such as Delhi to Jaipur or Chennai to Pondicherry leave the most time on the ground.


### **Is December a good time to visit Goa?**


December is a good time to visit Goa for weather, though the Christmas and New Year week is the busiest and most expensive.


### **When is the Hornbill Festival in 2026?**


The Hornbill Festival is scheduled for 1 to 10 December 2026 at Kisama Heritage Village near Kohima in Nagaland.


### **When is Rann Utsav in 2026 and 2027?**


Rann Utsav is listed for 1 November 2026 to 7 March 2027, with Christmas and New Year as the peak period.


### **Is Rajasthan good to visit in December?**


Rajasthan is good to visit in December because days are pleasant, evenings are cool and forts and lakes are comfortable to explore.


### **How early should I book a December bus ticket?**


For December travel, book bus tickets two to three weeks ahead, and earlier for the Christmas and New Year stretch.


### **What should I pack for a December trip in India?**


For a December trip in India, pack warm layers, a jacket for AC buses, a power bank and comfortable walking shoes.


### **Can fog affect bus travel in December?**


Fog can delay bus travel in north India in December, so avoid tight connections and keep a buffer on arrival day.


### **What is a good December travel plan for India?**


A good December travel plan for India is one theme, one destination and both bus legs booked together a few weeks ahead.
